comments.body: Done in c81e2812: a kept reply takes its banner down in the core the way a dismiss does; the shell's 4 s linger and 'Sent' line are gone. A refused or unknown reply keeps its banner with the words and the reason. A reply nobody live heard no longer keeps its banner (its outcome is in the run log). Fencil decision banner-reply-reads.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Reported by the owner, 2026-11-09: after he sends a reply from a message's banner, the banner stays up. It should close as soon as the reply is sent.

Not yet checked: what closes a banner today, and whether it waits for the message to read as read. An agent left in the Needs you strip after a reply may share the cause.
title: A message banner stays up after the reply to it is sent
